originality.rationale: 2026 paper's four-row torsion theorem covers a distinct balanced vector; the three newly classified vectors have max row capacity less than 6 and fail its full-row reduction, and the at-most-three-row theorem is inapplicable. Targeted parameter/alias searches and accessible earlier claims identify no covering homotopy theorem; unindexed equivalence risk remains.
residual_risks: An unindexed equivalent seven-column homotopy calculation may exist.
The result does not establish a formula for arbitrary capacities or symmetries.

value.rationale: The three previously untreated positive capacity partitions complete the torsion-free side of a canonical four-row seven-column capacity-eight boundary next to the 2026 two-torsion example. Exact integral wedge types establish nonshellable pure six-dimensional examples and distinguish 15 from 57 sphere multiplicities.
